name: 481. A query parameter sent more than once keeps every value through the transport plugins (repeated query) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-7042 regression. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream (the openai provider's base_url is the fixture). With a transport plugin loaded the gateway copied the query string into a map with one value per name and wrote it back, so the first value of a repeated parameter was replaced by the last: include=a&include=b reached the vendor as include=b&include=b, and a repeated after, order or provider was read as its last value. The fixture keeps each Responses lifecycle read in /__wire with the query string as it arrived. Each row sends parameters twice and reads back what the vendor received: every include value in the order sent, the first after and order, and the first provider. Run the whole folder in order.

item.name: openai GET /v1/responses/{id}/input_items with include, after and order sent twice: the vendor receives both include values in order and the first after and order (repeated query)

exec: pm.test('repeated query setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, text).to.equal(200); });
// wire: the requests that reached the fixture, with the query string as it arrived.
pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('exactly one upstream call', function () { pm.expect(calls, res.text()).to.have.length(1); });

pm.test('both include values arrive in the order sent, with the first after and order', function () { pm.expect((calls[0] || {}).query, res.text()).to.equal('?after=item_a&include=message.input_image.image_url&include=file_search_call.results&order=asc'); });
